subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
10. 
Operating income as a percentage of revenues of each product line, namely Fancy fans, 
Home decors, Assembled furniture, when all the support costs are allocated using an 
activity-based costing system would be: 
(a) 
4.42%, -20.42% and -1.36% respectively  
(b) 
10.78%, 0.60% and 8.75% respectively 
6 
(c) 
24.39%, 28.59% and 25.61% respectively  
(d) 
4.39%, 8.59% and -1.36% respectively 
(5 x 2 = 10 marks)
